_about: Editable rules for clean.py. Staff can update labels, aliases and thresholds here without touching code. Keys starting with '_' are comments.

columns._about: Each cleaned column is found by header text. 'all' = every substring must appear in the lower-cased header (non-breaking spaces removed). 'exact' = header must equal this.

likert_map._about: Keys are lower-cased, whitespace-normalized labels. Values are 1-5 scores.

likert_ambiguous_labels._about: Labels that are not on the agree/disagree scale and whose meaning is unconfirmed. Mapped to null in likert_map, so the cell is left unscored (the respondent's other answers are kept). The report counts excluded cells and shows a sensitivity check scoring them as below. If EveryMind confirms a meaning, put the score in likert_map.

dates._about: Dates are parsed one value at a time from a fixed list of unambiguous formats (e.g. 2026-04-28, April 28, 2026), so row order never matters. Slash dates like 04/05/2026 are ambiguous; they are read with slash_date_order ('MDY' = US month/day/year, as in this English (United States) Forms export, or 'DMY'). Set it to null to flag every slash date instead. Anything else is left blank and flagged, never guessed.

language_map._about: Matched on the start of the lower-cased label.

role_map._about: Role is multi-select (semicolon separated). Each label becomes an is_* column.

county_aliases._about: Keys are lower-cased county text with the word 'county' and extra spaces removed. Anything not listed is kept as typed with an 'UNRECOGNIZED:' prefix and flagged (flag_unmapped_value), never forced into a listed county.

_county_notes.Fairfax: Fairfax County is in Virginia, outside the Maryland counties in this dataset.
_county_notes.Harris: Not a Maryland county; the state cannot be determined from the data.

thresholds._fast_rationale: The form has 13 closed-ended items; under 20 seconds is under ~1.5 s per item (roughly the fastest 1% of responses). Counts at 25 s and 30 s are also reported so the choice can be checked.
thresholds._long_rationale: Most people finish in under 2 minutes (median 47 s), so over an hour usually means the tab was left open. Flagged for review only, never excluded.
thresholds._group_rationale: Groups under small_group_min_n are pooled into an Other (...) group; cells under it are suppressed, with complementary suppression so nothing can be recovered by subtraction. Groups under thin_group_n are shown but labeled descriptive only.

comment_response_types._about: A comment that exactly matches one of these phrases (after lower-casing and removing punctuation and apostrophes) gets that response type; anything else is 'substantive'. Blank cells are 'blank'. Wording is never changed. Praise, suggestions and questions are themes for the analysis stage, not cleaning.

redaction._about: Applied only to the *_redacted text columns. Original text stays in the main text columns for internal use. Automated redaction is preliminary (it only finds listed names, Mr./Ms./Dr. + name, emails and phone numbers), so review every excerpt manually before quoting or sharing it.
redaction._names_source: Names of real people found by manually reviewing comments are kept in names_file, which is gitignored so they never reach a shared repo. Copy redaction_names.example.json to that filename and add names there. Names listed in 'names' here are also used.
redaction._allowlist_note: 410-768-5522 appears in several comments as a crisis line taught in the training. Confirm with EveryMind. Any other phone number is redacted.
